podcast.body: This "austere" song by the Pet Shop Boys reached number one in May 1986. By this point, the narrator suggests it was "harder to say the second invasion was really invading anything anymore" as American tastes adapted. "But by the time the worldly pet shop boys took their austere West End girls to number one in May of 86, it was harder to say the second invasion was really invading anything anymore."
